body.x: MirraViz participated in “CES(Consumer Electronics Show) 2018 Unveiled” held on January 7, 2018 in Las Vegas, USA to introduce a multi-view system which enables each of several persons to simultaneously watch his or her own video on one screen surface.

MirraViz is a company which changes the digital display industry as it manufactures an innovative group of products including large-scale multi-view TVs, individualized digital signages, hybrid digital-print posters, and multi-shaped displays, etc. Technologies of MirraViz are applied in various fields for displays in exhibition halls of shopping malls, home games, exhibitions on entertainment, etc.

Using this home entertainment system developed by MirraViz, each of several persons can watch a video which he or she wants simultaneously on one screen surface, and therefore, you don’t have to argue for the channel which you want to watch. Similarly, the Gaming Chair Display System enables each of several persons to play his or her own games on one screen surface. These high-end gaming chairs are equipped with the functions of sound and vibration so that you can enjoy the games as if they are real.

Also, the “MirraViz UltraBright MultiView Screen” developed by MirraViz changes the environment for watching home projectors. With this product, you don’t have to increase the luminosity, nor do you have to use the curtain because the brightness becomes 100 times more than previous projector screens.

CES, the world’s largest IT exhibition, is an exhibition of trends in the global consumer electronics industry, held annually in January by the American Consumer Technology Association (CTA). Aving News reported the most issues of CES, MWC, and IFA, which are world's top three tech exhibitions, during last 11 years. It is sending special reporters to CES for this year as well; reporting major issues in the world market and introduce Korea's major companies all over the world.
